title: Delta Packet (GAD Tower Layer 8)
description: Captures a single agent action and its outcome, anchored to a context root. Tower Layer 8 variant — distinct from delta_packet.schema.json (slm model-correction packets). The context root supplies the shared prompt prefix; this packet supplies only the delta. High signal density: log correction-worthy divergences, not ambient telemetry.

packet_id.description: Unique ID for this packet. Format: '<agent>-<session_short>-<seq>'. Example: 'cc-a3f-042'.

root_id.description: ID of the context_root record this packet attaches to. Composes with root.shared_instruction at load time to form the full prompt.

model_at_capture.description: Model slug active when the action was taken. Example: 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.

agent_id_at_capture.description: Agent or worker ID from gad team registry, if dispatched.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action was captured.

input_summary.description: Compressed description of what triggered the action. Not the full prompt — that lives in the context_root. One or two sentences max.

action_taken.description: What the agent did. Tool call, code edit, decision, message — captured verbatim or summarized depending on size.

outcome.description: 'success' = operator accepted with no correction; 'failure' = correction required; 'partial' = partial correction applied.

cost_usd.description: API cost in USD at time of capture.

correction.description: The corrected output if outcome != success. Null for clean runs. This is the SFT target.

correction_source.description: Who or what authored the correction. 'verifier' = automated test harness.

quality_label.description: Curator label applied during promotion pipeline. Examples: 'approved', 'rejected', 'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'.

project_scope.description: gad projectid this packet belongs to. 'global', 'slm-learning', 'magicborn', etc.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering during curation. Examples: ['windows', 'tauri', 'test-repair'].

examples.input_summary: Operator asked agent to wire BYOK inline component into Kael chat stream.
examples.action_taken: Edited apps/desktop/src/components/kael/KaelFocusMode.tsx to render InlineByokRequest inside assistant-ui message stream.
